patterns.note: Sections are introduced with full-width, oversized typographic headings, often centered, creating strong visual breaks.
Dramatic contrast in font sizes and styles, pairing extremely large, bold sans-serif display fonts with elegant, condensed serifs and clean, smaller sans-serifs for labels and body text.
A high-contrast dark mode palette dominates, featuring deep black backgrounds with off-white text, accented by muted, warm gold or tan tones for specific section backgrounds or highlights.

The header transitions from transparent over the hero to a solid black, sticky bar with reduced height upon scroll. Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, and large typographic statements appear to animate into place.
Project showcases in the 'Selected Work' section use an asymmetrical grid layout with varying card sizes and some elements positioned off-center, breaking traditional grid rigidity.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero video or image is used as the initial viewport background, overlaid with large, high-contrast display typography.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, reveal content sections with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they become visible in the viewport.
The primary navigation bar is initially transparent and fixed, then transforms into a sticky, solid-background bar with a slightly reduced height after the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body) with elegant, condensed sub-headings and compact uppercase labels, creating a strong typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, contributing to a minimalist and high-end feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely oversized and highly stylized typography, particularly for section headings and the final 'CORY GROSSMANCO' statement, sets it apart. This, combined with a dark, minimalist aesthetic and subtle scroll-triggered reveals, makes the design feel more like an art piece or editorial layout than a typical portfolio.
